notes:
Describes a state of being under the control or authority of another. Composed of {従|じゅう} (follow, obey) and {属|ぞく} (belong to). Used in political, economic, social, and grammatical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {従属|じゅうぞく}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: subordinate relationship
- {従属|じゅうぞく}{的|てき}: dependent, subordinate (adjective)
- A⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{従属|じゅうぞく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: B is subordinate to A
- {従属|じゅうぞく}{節|せつ}: subordinate clause (grammar)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{依存|いぞん}→依存：11441_izon⟧: dependence — emphasizes reliance rather than power hierarchy
- ⟦{服従|ふくじゅう}→服従：15351_fukujuu⟧: obedience, submission — stronger, implies actively obeying
- ⟦{隷属|れいぞく}→隷属：20868_reizoku⟧: subjugation — implies being enslaved or in servitude
